question: Related Questions Q. Salah 1367 views Q. I have some questions, plz help me in them.. 1. When a person is travelling, he has to offer namaaz e Qasr.. What is the minimum distance of the journey after which he can be able to offer qasr.? If one gets to offer namaaz with jamaat while travelling, what shud he do.? And if he has already offered qasr namaaz and later sees that the namaaz is starting with jamaat, what shud he do.? 2. In the tashahud of the 2nd rakaat of every 4 rakaat namaaz, we have to read Attahayat and soon after Ashaduallah.... we have to get up for the 3rd rakaat without reading darood.. Why is it so that we shud not read darood here.? And take for example we join the jamaat in the 3rd rakaat, in the 4th rakaat's tashahud of jamaat, it will be our 2nd rakaat.. So in this, while everyone is reading atahayat, darood and dua, shud we also read the complete or we shud stop at ashaduallah.... ? 3. In fajr, after offering faraz namaaz we shud not offer any namaaz or sajda till ishrakh.. Is it the same in asar.? KHUDA HAFIZ 1934 views Q. I am working in Saudi, when I go to Umrah, I used to pray Maghrib and Isha on the way. I have to pray both salah at its scheduled time but peoples here praying Maghrib & Isha together as per shafai maslak, Now If I want to pray Maghrib but other peoples praying Isha salah ba Jamat. My question is, Can I pray behind them making my niyah as Maghrib. 2792 views Q. In lieu of below fatwa we have asked the same two months earlier with Moulana/Mufti Anees Sb of chouhan bangar,Jafrabad & he told that " Ise Momool na banaye lekin jamat e sani agar kabhi kabhi karni ho to kar sakte hai, aur uske liye main mussallah chor kar kahi bhi jamat e sani kar sakte hai aur yeh jamat bina Ehqamat ke karni hogi, Imam bina takbeer ke niyat bandh le. Now please see above lines and clarify the same. Jaza kallah previously Asked: Agar Masjid main Kharji hissa na ho aur kabhi kabhi jamat e sani karni ho to kya kar sakte hai aur uska kya tareeqa hoga? Answer: 9900 04 Jan, 2009 (Fatwa: 22/18=B/1429) According to Hanafi Fiqh, second Jamat is makrooh in the mosque of locality. If the jamat is once performed there is no need to do the second jamat. Remaining people should offer salah individually. If there is any shop, house or open place outside the main mosque where jamat is possible then it can be done there. and Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) Knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband 2287 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 9555 Country: Bangladesh Title: Assalamualaikum Hadhrat i hv a question regurding da matter of 'Du-allin' or 'Zu-allin'! Which one is right and how? my uncle who followDeobandi Maslaik in Pakistan, he say that 'Zu-allin' is right bt our Musfti Saheb who certify from Darul Uloom Deoband says that 'Du-allin' is right! Please tell me which one is right and how(details)? Question: Assalamualaikum Hadhrat i hv a question regurding da matter of 'Du-allin' or 'Zu-allin'! Which one is right and how? my uncle who followDeobandi Maslaik in Pakistan, he say that 'Zu-allin' is right bt our Musfti Saheb who certify from Darul Uloom Deoband says that 'Du-allin' is right! Please tell me which one is right and how(details)? Answer ID: 9555 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 60/61=L/1429) Zuad ( ض ) should be pronounced with its original pronunciation, it is not right to pronounce it like dal ( د ); therefore the Mufti Sahib is wrong who says it should be recited duallin instead of zuallin . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
